errors.text: The falsification threshold is set to 5 meV/atom rather than the required 0.5 meV/atom, making the proposed test an order of magnitude too permissive.
The stated supercell boundary of at least 500 atoms does not reconstruct the specified 12x12x12, 3456-atom cell needed for the SRO analysis.

The hypothesis incorrectly implies that the MTP itself captures electronic density-of-states and electronic-excitation contributions; these are electronic free-energy terms that require explicit DFT-level treatment rather than a conventional configurational MTP.
